name: Buildkite
summary: Buildkite runs pipelines on agents that a team can host itself or rent from Buildkite. Free includes up to 2,000 Linux vCPU minutes a month, and Pro costs $30 per active user a month with 4,000 minutes. Hosted Linux minutes cost $0.004 per vCPU on Pro.

facts.text: Pro is priced per active user, defined as a unique user who accesses the system in a given month.
Hosted agent rates on Pro are $0.004 per vCPU minute on Linux, $0.008 on Windows and $0.02 on Mac.
A 30-day trial gives full access to the platform and needs no credit card.
A block step pauses a build until a team member unblocks it in the web UI or API, and allowed_teams restricts who may approve.
Job log archives can be stored in the customer's own S3 bucket on the Enterprise plan.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 2,000 Linux vCPU minutes a month

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 4,000 Linux AMD64 vCPU minutes a month. Hosted Linux $0.004, Windows $0.008 and Mac $0.02 per vCPU minute

hiddenCosts: The pricing page gives hosted per-minute rates for Pro only, not for Free or Enterprise.
Self-hosted agents mean the team pays for its own compute.
